title: Fire At Mall/Home Depot Entrance Last Night
content: I never really post on here, just usually compare my experiences with everyone else' BUT I literally JUST woke up from a dream that I became lucid in towards the end and all I remember was trying to leave this Home Depot/ department store in my dream last night. (My department stores have really high ceilings and they almost feels outside, but it's not) I don't know why I really wanted to leave, but all I know is that I couldn't. The workers kept telling me there was a fire in the front and that it would be hard for me to leave. (anyone else had a unexplained fire happen outside their Mall World last night?) I think that's when towards the end end, it changed into an arcade and I ended up with my "friends." I always end up with the same group of people, and I've never met any of them in the waking world. One is of course my boyfriend, but the other three people is one girl who's always with me and then two others, a girl and another guy. I don't know. I have a lot of other Mall World experiences that I've written in my journal! But I'm trying to also figure out who these people are. They came over to my house in my dream last night, and I made spaghetti for everyone, and one of the guys made cookies. I don't know...its random but I'm trying to find out who these people are in my dreams that are ALWAYS around me.
